storyboard:
Title: Harmonica Frenzy

Total duration: 15 seconds

Genre: Comedy
Mood: Joy

Character prompt format:
Name: Yellow
Age/Role: Crewmate
Face: Bright yellow visor, cheerful expression
Hair: None
Clothing: Standard crew uniform
Distinctive prop: Oversized harmonica
Emotion: Excitement
Body language: Bouncy movements, raised arms
Consistency notes: Always wears a bright smile

Image style prompt:
Lighting: Soft, warm glow
Composition: Close-up shots of Yellow's face and hands
Camera feel: Fast-paced, dynamic cuts
Detail level: High contrast between clean lines and messy harmonica parts
Continuity: Quick camera movements to convey energy

Overall art style prompt:
Palette: Bright primary colors (yellow, blue, red)
World design: Simple, stylized spaceship interior
Mood: Upbeat, playful
Cinematic quality: Fast-paced editing, dynamic camera angles
Sora-friendly clarity: Clear visual storytelling, minimal clutter

Scene 1 - 0s:
Yellow enters the Engineer's workshop, eyes widening as they spot the oversized harmonica on a workbench.

Scene 2 - 3s:
Yellow picks up the harmonica, fingers trembling with excitement, and starts to play. The camera zooms in on the instrument as cartoonish musical notes start popping out.

Scene 3 - 6s:
As Yellow continues to play, the musical notes grow larger and more vibrant, filling the workshop with a joyful atmosphere. The camera spins around Yellow's head, capturing their carefree expression.

Scene 4 - 9s:
The musical notes start bouncing off the walls and ceiling, creating a playful obstacle course for Yellow to navigate while still playing the harmonica. The camera cuts between shots of Yellow dodging the notes and the notes themselves.

Scene 5 - 12s:
Yellow finally finishes playing, and the last note pops out as a confetti-like explosion of color. The camera zooms out to show Yellow beaming with happiness, surrounded by the lingering musical notes.
